description: This file implements a Discord voice manager for handling voice sessions, including joining/leaving channels, processing audio streams, transcribing audio, and generating speech responses within a Discord bot environment. It manages voice connections, handles audio decoding, transcription, TTS, and error recovery.

classes.name: DiscordVoiceManager
classes.description: Manages Discord voice sessions, including joining/leaving channels, processing audio streams, transcription, TTS, and error recovery.

classes.name: DiscordVoiceReadyListener
classes.description: Listener that triggers auto-join of voice channels when Discord client is ready.

methods.name: mergeTtsConfig
methods.description: Merges base TTS configuration with an override, combining providers and model overrides.

methods.name: resolveVoiceTtsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the effective TTS configuration, merging overrides and base config.

methods.name: buildWavBuffer
methods.description: Constructs a WAV file buffer from PCM data.

methods.name: createOpusDecoder
methods.description: Creates an Opus decoder instance if available.

methods.name: decodeOpusStream
methods.description: Decodes an Opus stream into PCM buffers.

methods.name: estimateDurationSeconds
methods.description: Estimates audio duration from PCM buffer length.

methods.name: writeWavFile
methods.description: Writes PCM data to a temporary WAV file and schedules cleanup.

methods.name: scheduleTempCleanup
methods.description: Schedules deletion of temporary files/directories after a delay.

methods.name: transcribeAudio
methods.description: Transcribes audio from a WAV file using the plugin SDK.

methods.name: handleSpeakingStart
methods.description: Handles the start of speech from a user, decoding audio, transcribing, and generating responses.

methods.name: processSegment
methods.description: Processes a recorded audio segment: transcription, authorization, TTS, and playback.

methods.name: handleReceiveError
methods.description: Handles errors during audio reception, including decrypt failures and recovery.

methods.name: resetDecryptFailureState
methods.description: Resets decrypt failure counters.

methods.name: recoverFromDecryptFailures
methods.description: Attempts to recover from repeated decrypt failures by rejoining the voice channel.

methods.name: resolveSpeakerIsOwner
methods.description: Determines if a speaker is an owner based on allow list.

methods.name: resolveSpeakerContextCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for speaker context.

methods.name: getCachedSpeakerContext
methods.description: Retrieves cached speaker context if valid.

methods.name: setCachedSpeakerContext
methods.description: Stores speaker context in cache.

methods.name: resolveSpeakerContext
methods.description: Resolves speaker context, using cache or fetching identity.

methods.name: resolveSpeakerIdentity
methods.description: Fetches user/member identity info from Discord client.
